_about: Store policy catalogue. Written from knowledge of the Apple App Review Guidelines and the Google Play Developer Program Policies as of 2026; every entry must be verified against the current official text (web access is off in this session). 'applies' = feature tags detected per app; 'check' = auto:<existing check> | human: | founder: | n/a.

rules.title: Objectionable content
rules.rule: No offensive, discriminatory, violent, sexual or defamatory content.
rules.check: human: review every screen and bundled content

rules.title: False information / trick features
rules.rule: No fake functionality, misleading claims or prank features.

rules.title: User-generated content
rules.rule: UGC needs filtering, a report mechanism, user blocking and published contact info.

rules.title: Kids Category
rules.rule: Kids apps: no third-party analytics/ads without parental gates and compliance.
rules.check: human: confirm the app is not in the Kids category or meets 1.3

rules.title: Physical harm
rules.rule: Medical/health claims must be accurate; no dangerous activities; disclose limitations.
rules.check: human: health claims backed, disclaimer present

rules.title: Medical apps
rules.rule: Apps that measure health data must be validated or clearly say they are not medical devices.

rules.title: Developer information
rules.rule: Easy way to contact the developer (support URL working).
rules.check: auto:store_checklist:Privacy & support URLs serve the right page

rules.title: Data security
rules.rule: Appropriate security for user data.
rules.check: auto:appsec (secure storage, no secrets in binary)

rules.title: Reporting criminal activity / emergency
rules.rule: Apps reporting crime or emergencies must involve local law enforcement and be by appropriate entities.
rules.check: human: Kinnav-type safety features use the real emergency number and say what they do

rules.title: App completeness — crashes
rules.rule: Launches and works on the latest iOS on iPhone and iPad; no crashes, broken links or placeholder content.

rules.title: App completeness — in-app purchases
rules.rule: IAP products complete and submitted with the binary; review access to paid features.

rules.title: Information Needed
rules.rule: Demo account or demo mode for gated features; review notes complete.
rules.check: auto:store_checklist:Demo account when the app gates on sign-in + Review notes answer Apple's 7 items

rules.title: Beta testing
rules.rule: No demos, betas or trial versions in the App Store.

rules.title: Accurate metadata
rules.rule: Description, screenshots, previews reflect the core experience; no hidden features.

rules.title: Hidden or undocumented features
rules.rule: No hidden, dormant or undocumented features; no remote switches that change behaviour after review.

rules.title: Screenshots
rules.rule: Show the app in use — not just title art, login or splash.

rules.title: App previews
rules.rule: Previews show only video captured from the app.

rules.title: Age rating
rules.rule: Answer the age-rating questions honestly.

rules.title: Name, keywords, metadata
rules.rule: Unique name ≤30; no trademarks, prices, other apps' names, or irrelevant keywords.
rules.check: auto:store_checklist name/keywords limits + human: no competitor names in keywords

rules.title: Metadata for all audiences
rules.rule: Icons, screenshots and previews suitable for 4+.

rules.title: Third-party platforms
rules.rule: No mention of other mobile platforms (Android, Google Play) in metadata or UI.
rules.check: auto:grep 'Android|Google Play|Play Store' in iOS metadata and iOS UI strings

rules.title: iPad support
rules.rule: iPhone apps should run on iPad.

rules.title: Power efficiency
rules.rule: No unrelated background processes, mining, or battery drain.
rules.check: human + auto:background modes declared vs used

rules.title: Mac App Store
rules.rule: n/a (iOS only)

rules.title: Public APIs only
rules.rule: Only public APIs; no private frameworks.
rules.check: auto:binary scan for private API strings (appsec)

rules.title: Self-contained
rules.rule: No downloading/executing code that changes features.

rules.title: Background modes
rules.rule: Use background services only for their intended purpose (audio, location, VoIP…).

rules.title: WebKit
rules.rule: Web browsing must use WebKit.

rules.title: Recording consent
rules.rule: Explicit consent and visible indication when recording users.

rules.title: Files / external storage
rules.rule: Use the Files app properly.

rules.title: Widgets/extensions
rules.rule: Extensions must be related to the app.

rules.title: Ads
rules.rule: Ads only in the main app binary; age-appropriate; no ads in extensions, keyboards or widgets; easy to close.
rules.check: auto:ads not in extensions + human: interstitial frequency/close

rules.title: In-App Purchase
rules.rule: Digital goods/features must use IAP; no external purchase links for digital content.
rules.check: auto:no Stripe/PayPal for digital goods + apple_requirements:iap-2.1b

rules.title: Subscriptions
rules.rule: Ongoing value; clear terms, price, period; restore purchases; links to terms and privacy.

rules.title: Other purchase methods
rules.rule: Reader apps, multiplatform services, person-to-person services — specific rules.

rules.title: Hardware-specific content
rules.rule: Unlocking via hardware rules.

rules.title: Acceptable business models
rules.rule: Affiliate/commission links and real-world goods allowed when disclosed and appropriate.

rules.title: Unacceptable: creating an interface for displaying third-party apps or ads
rules.rule: No apps primarily for ads/affiliate catalogues; no incentivised actions.
rules.check: human: app has value beyond links (4.3 spec)

rules.title: Design
rules.rule: Simple, refined, intuitive UI; meets HIG basics.

rules.title: Copycats
rules.rule: No copying other apps' icons, names or UI.

rules.title: Minimum functionality
rules.rule: Beyond a repackaged website; lasting entertainment or utility value.

rules.title: App generation services
rules.rule: Not created from a commercialized template unless submitted by the content provider.
rules.check: auto:Real Apps QA + differentiation answers (store_checklist 4.3 statement)

rules.title: Spam — duplicates
rules.rule: Don't submit multiple apps with the same functionality; consolidate.

rules.title: Saturated categories
rules.rule: Unique high-quality experience required in saturated categories.

rules.title: Extensions
rules.rule: Keyboard/Safari/other extensions follow their rules (e.g. keyboard works offline without full access).

rules.title: Push notifications
rules.rule: Not required to use the app; no marketing pushes without opt-in; no sensitive data in pushes.
rules.check: human + auto:push permission not requested at launch

rules.title: Mini apps / HTML5 / AI chatbots
rules.rule: Software not embedded in the binary must follow guidelines; AI content disclosed and moderated.
rules.check: human: AI output moderated and labelled

rules.title: Login services
rules.rule: If third-party/social login is used, offer an equivalent privacy-focused login (e.g. Sign in with Apple).
rules.check: auto:Sign in with Apple offered when Google/Facebook login is offered

rules.title: Streaming games
rules.rule: n/a

rules.title: Privacy policy
rules.rule: Policy linked in App Store Connect and inside the app; says what is collected, how, and deletion.
rules.check: auto:policy page live + in-app privacy link (grep)

rules.title: Permission
rules.rule: Get consent before collecting data; purpose strings explain why.

rules.title: Data minimization
rules.rule: Request only data relevant to the core function.

rules.title: Access
rules.rule: Respect permission denial; don't force consent; offer alternatives.
rules.check: human: app still works after denying each permission

rules.title: Account sign-in & deletion
rules.rule: Don't require login unless needed; if accounts are created, in-app deletion.

rules.title: Regulated fields
rules.rule: Banking, health, crypto, legal, gov apps must come from the qualified entity.
rules.check: human: app is a tool, not a regulated service (or entity qualifies)

rules.title: Data use and sharing
rules.rule: ATT required before tracking; no sharing without consent.

rules.title: Health and health research
rules.rule: HealthKit/health data not for ads or data mining; accurate; consent.

rules.title: Kids
rules.rule: COPPA/GDPR-K compliance if kids' data.

rules.title: Location services
rules.rule: Only when directly relevant; purpose explained; background only if needed.
rules.check: auto:location purpose strings + no always-location unless used

rules.title: Intellectual property — generally
rules.rule: Only content you own or have licensed (logos, maps, data, music, fonts).
rules.check: human: data-source licences and fonts (OFL etc.)

rules.title: Third-party sites/services
rules.rule: Permission/terms for using third-party services and data (APIs).
rules.check: human: each API's terms allow commercial use (e.g. OpenSky)

rules.title: Audio/video downloading
rules.rule: No illegal downloading/streaming of third-party content.
rules.check: human: radio/video sources licensed for the use

rules.title: Apple products
rules.rule: No Apple trademarks misuse.

rules.title: Gaming, gambling, lotteries
rules.rule: Rules for contests and real-money gambling.

rules.title: VPN apps
rules.rule: VPN only via NEVPNManager by organizations; declare.

rules.title: Mobile device management
rules.rule: n/a

rules.title: Developer Code of Conduct
rules.rule: Honest, no manipulation, no hidden features, no review manipulation; respond to App Review.
rules.check: auto:code-hygiene hidden-feature scan + founder: MA-043 replies

rules.title: App Store reviews
rules.rule: No incentivised or fake reviews; use SKStoreReviewController.

rules.title: Privacy manifest — required-reason APIs
rules.rule: Declare reasons for UserDefaults, file timestamp, boot time, disk space APIs in PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
rules.check: auto:privacy manifest declares required reasons used by the binary

rules.title: Third-party SDK privacy manifests
rules.rule: Listed SDKs ship their own privacy manifests and signatures.

rules.title: Purpose strings
rules.rule: Info.plist purpose string for every API the binary references.

rules.title: Encryption declaration
rules.rule: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption answered.

rules.title: Target API level
rules.rule: New apps/updates target the current required Android API level.

rules.title: 16 KB page-size support
rules.rule: Native libraries aligned for 16 KB page sizes (Android 15+ requirement for new apps/updates).

rules.title: Android App Bundle + Play App Signing
rules.rule: Publish as AAB, signed with the upload key.

rules.title: Data safety form
rules.rule: Declare collection/sharing/security accurately for the app and its SDKs.
rules.check: auto:privacy-engineer inventory vs docs/console-answers + founder: Console form

rules.title: User Data policy
rules.rule: Prominent disclosure + consent before collecting personal/sensitive data; privacy policy in Console and in app.

rules.title: Account deletion requirement
rules.rule: Apps with account creation offer in-app and web deletion; URL in Data safety.

rules.title: Permissions and APIs that access sensitive info
rules.rule: Request only needed permissions; justify sensitive ones.

rules.title: Background location
rules.rule: Background location only with core feature need, prominent disclosure and Console declaration.
rules.check: auto:no ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION unless used + founder: declaration

rules.title: Photo and video permissions
rules.rule: READ_MEDIA_IMAGES/VIDEO only for core use; otherwise use the system photo picker.
rules.check: auto:no READ_MEDIA_* unless core + photo picker used

rules.title: Foreground service types
rules.rule: Declare the type and justify in Console (Android 14+).
rules.check: auto:FGS types declared + founder: Console declaration

rules.title: SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM / USE_EXACT_ALARM
rules.rule: Only for alarm/calendar core functionality.

rules.title: SMS and Call Log permissions
rules.rule: Restricted to default handlers or approved exceptions.

rules.title: MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
rules.rule: Only for file managers/backup etc. with declaration.

rules.title: QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES
rules.rule: Only with approved use; use <queries> instead.

rules.title: AccessibilityService API
rules.rule: Only for accessibility purposes, with disclosure and declaration.

rules.title: REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES
rules.rule: Only for core app-install functionality.

rules.title: Health apps
rules.rule: Health Connect access declared; health apps declaration form.
rules.check: founder: Health apps declaration in Console + privacy-engineer

rules.title: Financial services declaration
rules.rule: Declare financial features; loan apps have extra rules.
rules.check: founder: Console declaration (tools/calculators answer 'no financial service')

rules.title: Ads policy
rules.rule: No deceptive/disruptive ads; interstitials not unexpected; no ads on lock screen; families-safe if targeting kids.
rules.check: auto:AdMob ad placement review + human: interstitial frequency

rules.title: Advertising ID declaration
rules.rule: Declare AD_ID permission use in Console.
rules.check: founder: Console Advertising ID declaration (answers in console-answers)

rules.title: Families policy / target audience
rules.rule: Target audience declared; if children are included, Families requirements and certified ad SDKs.
rules.check: founder: Target audience form + auto:ads SDK config

rules.title: IARC questionnaire
rules.rule: Complete the content rating questionnaire.
rules.check: founder: Console IARC (store_checklist: Play IARC questionnaire)

rules.title: Store listing and promotion
rules.rule: No misleading metadata, keyword stuffing, unattributed testimonials, or performance claims; icon/screenshots accurate.

rules.title: Impersonation and IP
rules.rule: No imitation of other apps/brands; licensed content only.

rules.title: Spam and minimum functionality
rules.rule: No repetitive content, duplicate apps, webview-only wrappers.

rules.title: Deceptive behavior
rules.rule: App does what the listing says; no hidden features or false claims.

rules.title: Mobile unwanted software
rules.rule: No undisclosed data collection, no hiding icons, no unexpected behaviour.

rules.title: User-generated content
rules.rule: Moderation, reporting, blocking, terms for UGC apps.

rules.title: AI-generated content
rules.rule: Generative AI apps prevent offensive output and let users report it.

rules.title: Payments policy
rules.rule: Digital goods via Google Play Billing; physical goods may use other methods.

rules.title: Subscriptions policy
rules.rule: Clear offer terms; easy cancellation; no misleading trials.

rules.title: Real-money gambling
rules.rule: Restricted.

rules.title: Health content
rules.rule: No medical misinformation; disclaimers.

rules.title: News apps
rules.rule: News apps must provide sources and contact info; Google News policies.

rules.title: Dating apps
rules.rule: Age gate 18+, safety features, UGC rules.

rules.title: Government apps
rules.rule: Must be official or clearly not affiliated.
rules.check: human: Uscis-Case states it is not affiliated with USCIS

rules.title: Device and network abuse
rules.rule: No interfering with other apps/services; respect API terms.

rules.title: Background work / battery
rules.rule: Respect background limits.

rules.title: App access declaration
rules.rule: Provide reviewer access instructions for gated features.
rules.check: founder: Console App access (answers in console-answers)

rules.title: Developer contact info
rules.rule: Valid email, website, privacy policy URL in Console.

rules.title: Pre-launch report
rules.rule: Fix crashes/ANRs/security warnings in the pre-launch report.
rules.check: human: read pre-launch report after internal upload
